transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot. Like I can’t really shut the motor off. And lately it’s been causing problems at the firehouse.
How long have you been feeling this way—did it come on gradually over time, or was there a distinct period when you noticed this 'running hot' feeling start?

It wasn’t like one day it just started. It’s been… maybe a year and five months where it’s been a real problem. Around when the longer rotating shifts started, and then the extra documentation and drone stuff got added on. Since then it’s just been harder to keep a lid on.
Have you noticed any physical changes along with this 'running hot' feeling—like a racing heart, tremor, excessive sweating, or unintended weight loss?
Not really. I mean… I get keyed up, but I haven’t noticed weight dropping off or shaking or anything like that. Nothing obvious.
Thinking back to when you were a kid, did you have similar struggles with restlessness, difficulty focusing, or feeling 'wound up,' even before adulthood?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t remember all of it clearly, but my mom says I was like that in grade school. Always getting up, blurting stuff out, losing homework. Notes home from teachers… even though I could do the work.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things—like work, finances, or family—and having a hard time controlling that worry, even when there's no immediate problem?
I don’t think so… not like constant worrying about everything. I get stressed when there’s something going on, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around worrying when there’s no reason.

Have you ever had a distinct period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually elated, irritable, or full of energy and needed much less sleep than usual, separate from how you feel most of the time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have times I’m more amped up or irritated, but not like some separate stretch for days where I barely sleep and feel great or anything.
Outside of work, do you notice these same problems—like difficulty focusing, restlessness, or feeling keyed up—affecting things at home or in your relationships?

Yeah… it shows up at home too. Like on days off, if we’re supposed to just sit and do something quiet as a family, I don’t last long. I’ll start talking, or I’m up checking something in the garage, messing with tools… just moving around before I even realize I got up.
Do you recall these kinds of restlessness or focus problems being noticeable before you turned 12 years old?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t remember all of it clearly, but my mom’s told me I was like that in grade school—up out of my seat, blurting stuff out, losing homework. I guess they sent notes home a lot, even though I could do the work.
